title: Store private screenshots

prompts.en-US: Your game saves player screenshots in Amazon S3. How are the screenshots organised, and how would you prevent everyone on the internet from reading them?
prompts.zh-HK: 你嘅遊戲用 Amazon S3 儲存玩家截圖。截圖會點樣組織？你會點樣防止所有網民都讀到佢哋？

concepts.description: Screenshots are stored as objects in a bucket.
Keep public access blocked and permit only authorised access using access policies or a limited presigned URL.

misconceptions: All S3 objects are automatically public.
acceptableAnswers: Files in a bucket with public access blocked and permission for the game's role.
referenceAnswer: Store screenshots as objects inside a bucket. Keep the bucket private with public access blocked and grant only the required access.

title: Store game assets

prompts.en-US: Why would you use Amazon S3 for game images and sound files? Give one example of an object you would store.
prompts.zh-HK: 點解你會用 Amazon S3 儲存遊戲圖片同音效檔案？請舉一個你會儲存嘅物件例子。

concepts.description: S3 provides object storage for files rather than running the game server.
Gives a concrete file example such as a character image, screenshot or sound effect.

misconceptions: S3 runs the game's server program.
acceptableAnswers: Keep the dragon image as a file in S3 so the game can retrieve it.
referenceAnswer: S3 stores files as objects. I could store the dragon image or a spell sound effect there for the game to retrieve.

title: Run a game server

prompts.en-US: You want to run your own game server on Amazon EC2. What does EC2 provide, and give an example of software you can control on it?
prompts.zh-HK: 你想用 Amazon EC2 運行自己嘅遊戲伺服器。EC2 提供啲乜？請舉例說明你可以控制邊啲軟件。

concepts.description: EC2 provides a virtual server or computer for running applications.
Can choose or configure an operating system, install the game server, or update its software.

misconceptions: EC2 is only a bucket for storing files.
acceptableAnswers: A cloud computer where I can install and update a Linux game server.
referenceAnswer: EC2 gives me a virtual server. I can choose Linux, install the game server software and manage its updates.

title: Limit server traffic

prompts.en-US: Your EC2 game server needs one game port. How could a security group limit access, and why should you avoid allowing every inbound port?
prompts.zh-HK: 你嘅 EC2 遊戲伺服器只需要一個遊戲連接埠。安全群組可以點樣限制存取？點解唔應該開放所有入站連接埠？

concepts.description: Allow the required game port and restrict sources or administrative access through security group rules.
Unnecessary open ports expose services that players do not need and increase unwanted access risk.

misconceptions: Every inbound port must be open for one game port to work.
acceptableAnswers: Allow only the game's port for players and keep SSH limited to administrators.
referenceAnswer: Allow the game port and only the needed sources. Restrict administrative ports because unnecessary open services increase exposure.

title: Give only needed permissions

prompts.en-US: A game component only reads images from one S3 bucket. What permissions should its IAM role have, and why not give it administrator access?
prompts.zh-HK: 一個遊戲元件只需要讀取一個 S3 儲存桶入面嘅圖片。佢嘅 IAM 角色應該有咩權限？點解唔畀佢管理員權限？

concepts.description: Limit the role to reading the needed objects in that bucket, not writing or unrelated resources.
Least privilege limits accidental changes or damage if the component is compromised.

misconceptions: Administrator access is necessary to read an S3 image.
acceptableAnswers: Read-only permission for that bucket so a mistake cannot delete other resources.
referenceAnswer: Grant only the required object read permissions on that bucket. Avoid administrator access to limit accidental or malicious changes.

title: Use a role for an application

prompts.en-US: Why should a game application on EC2 use an IAM role instead of putting permanent AWS access keys in its source code?
prompts.zh-HK: 點解 EC2 上嘅遊戲應用程式應該用 IAM 角色，而唔係將永久 AWS 存取金鑰寫入原始碼？

concepts.description: An IAM role provides temporary credentials to the application.
Avoids embedding long-lived keys that can leak through source code or copies of the application.

misconceptions: Source code is always a safe place for permanent access keys.
acceptableAnswers: The role supplies temporary credentials so leaked code does not expose a permanent key.
referenceAnswer: The role supplies temporary credentials. I do not need to embed a permanent key that might leak with the code.

title: Organise a game network

prompts.en-US: What does an Amazon VPC give your game infrastructure, and name one network setting you can control?
prompts.zh-HK: Amazon VPC 為你嘅遊戲基礎設施提供啲乜？請講出一個你可以控制嘅網絡設定。

concepts.description: A logically isolated virtual network for AWS resources.
Names a controllable setting such as subnets, IP ranges, routing or network access rules.

misconceptions: A VPC is just a database table.
acceptableAnswers: My own virtual network where I choose subnets and routes.
referenceAnswer: A VPC is a logically isolated virtual network for my resources. I can choose subnets, address ranges and routes.

title: Keep a database off the public internet

prompts.en-US: Your game has a public web server and a database used only by that server. How would you separate their network access?
prompts.zh-HK: 你嘅遊戲有一個公開網頁伺服器，同一個只供佢使用嘅資料庫。你會點樣分開佢哋嘅網絡存取？

concepts.description: Keep the database in a private subnet without direct public internet access.
Allow database traffic only from the application server using restrictive network rules.

misconceptions: The database must be open to everyone because the web server is public.
acceptableAnswers: A private database subnet with a security group allowing only the web server.
referenceAnswer: Keep the database private and allow its required port only from the web application, not all internet clients.

title: React to a screenshot upload

prompts.en-US: When a screenshot is uploaded to S3, your game should create a thumbnail. How could AWS Lambda help, and what starts the work?
prompts.zh-HK: 當截圖上載到 S3，遊戲需要建立縮圖。AWS Lambda 可以點樣幫手？由咩觸發呢項工作？

concepts.description: Lambda executes the thumbnail processing function without managing a continuously running server.
An S3 object-created/upload event can trigger the function.

misconceptions: Lambda automatically knows to process every upload without a configured trigger.
acceptableAnswers: Configure an S3 upload event to run thumbnail code in Lambda.
referenceAnswer: Configure an S3 upload event to invoke a Lambda function that creates the thumbnail, without maintaining a dedicated server.

title: Choose event-driven compute

prompts.en-US: A game occasionally needs a short function to validate a submitted score. Why might Lambda fit better than keeping a dedicated server running for that task?
prompts.zh-HK: 遊戲間中需要用一個短函數驗證提交嘅分數。點解 Lambda 可能比一直開住專用伺服器更適合呢項工作？

concepts.description: Runs the function when a submission or event arrives rather than keeping an idle dedicated server.
AWS manages the underlying servers and capacity for the function.

misconceptions: Using Lambda means there are no servers anywhere.
acceptableAnswers: Run on each submission and let AWS manage the machines instead of maintaining an idle server.
referenceAnswer: Lambda runs when a score submission invokes it. AWS manages the underlying servers, so I need not maintain an idle dedicated server for this short task.

title: Store player progress

prompts.en-US: How could a DynamoDB table store each player's level and completed missions? What key would you use to find one player's record?
prompts.zh-HK: 你可以點樣用 DynamoDB 資料表儲存每位玩家嘅等級同已完成任務？你會用咩鍵搵返某位玩家嘅記錄？

concepts.description: Store a player's progress as an item with level and mission attributes in a table.
Use a unique player identifier as a key to retrieve the correct player's item.

misconceptions: All players should share the same primary key and overwrite the same item.
acceptableAnswers: An item per player with player ID as key and level and missions as attributes.
referenceAnswer: Store an item for each player containing level and missions. Use the unique player ID as the key to retrieve that player's progress.

title: Avoid overwriting a newer save

prompts.en-US: Two devices load the same saved game. One saves new progress first. How could a DynamoDB conditional write stop the other device from overwriting that newer save?
prompts.zh-HK: 兩部裝置載入同一個遊戲存檔，其中一部先儲存咗新進度。DynamoDB 條件式寫入可以點樣防止另一部覆蓋較新嘅存檔？

concepts.description: Write only if the stored revision or version still matches the revision that the device loaded.
If the version changed, reject the stale write and reload or resolve the newer save instead of silently overwriting it.

misconceptions: A stale save should always overwrite the latest version.
acceptableAnswers: Compare the saved revision and refuse the write if another device already increased it.
referenceAnswer: Require the stored revision to match the loaded revision. If it has changed, reject the stale write and reload or resolve the conflict.
